Why Collagen-Based Dressing?

Studies have shown that collagen plays an important role in the body’s natural healing process:

• Supports formation of a natural healing scaffold • Helps maintain a moist environment for skin recovery • Encourages the body’s normal clotting response • Attracts cells involved in tissue repair

Not all collagen is the same.

Type I collagen (commonly sourced from bovine) is widely used in medical applications due to:

• High structural similarity to human skin collagen

• Strong integrity and absorption characteristics

• Consistent quality and purity

Who Should Keep This at Home?

✔ Families with children ✔ Elderly individuals with delicate skin ✔ Individuals on blood thinners ✔ Anyone building a complete first aid kit

Inspired by Real Needs

Add Hemari Collagen Pad to your first aid kit today.
